name: IPEval
description: IPEval is the first evaluation benchmark tailored for intellectual property agency and consulting tasks, comprising 2657 multiple-choice questions across creation, application, protection, and management of IP. It covers various IP domains including patents, trademarks, copyrights, and trade secrets, and supports evaluation in English and Chinese.
reputation: Aims to spur development of specialized IP models; publicly available with a dedicated website.
notes: Includes zero-shot, few-shot, and Chain of Thought evaluation methods; highlights regional and temporal legal nuances.
